data.key: Wild Stalker ~ Rage of the Wild
data.name: Rage of the Wild
data.description: At 4th level, a wild stalker gains the rage ability as the barbarian class feature, but its barbarian level is considered to be his ranger level -3. This ability replaces hunter's bond.
